title: pm-dispatch: contract-review.md and the record templates trail the verifier's session-evidence limit and the new SQL push-down ③ check
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (follow-ups owed by work in flight: PR #33711 (card #33603) at-tier record 6890932729, and PR #33693 (card #33627) at-tier delta record 6890853677).

Two rule texts now trail the tools:

1. **Session evidence.** After PR #33711, `verify-review-tier.mjs` refuses a delegating session's own transcript (a session that spawned a sub-agent), and the sub-agent route is the reviewing agent's own transcript. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` (line 37 area) still teaches the in-seat route without that limit. The file is at its 63-line ceiling.
2. **The new ③ check.** PR #33693 adds a ③ line every record carries (SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join without a reason is a finding). `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --brief-template` still defines ③ as dev flags and `open_questions` only, and the `--template` legend has no ③ entry, so a sub-agent working from the brief alone does not see the check. "记发现" also names no carrier on a faceless PR (seat self-read).

## What lands

contract-review.md states the session-evidence limit (paid in place, ⛔ no ceiling raised); the two templates carry the ③ check; the faceless-PR carrier is named. Waits for PRs #33711 and #33693 to merge.
